headline: HSV-1 gBに結合する抗体D48は、ドメインIIの軽鎖側に触れる
subhead: gBとD48 Fabの3.04 Åクライオ電顕構造。DIIは他のヘルペスウイルスでも抗体の標的になる

summary.question: gB の抗体がウイルスをどう中和するのか、構造の基盤は分かっていなかった。
summary.approach: HSV-1 gB の細胞外領域と D48 Fab を HEK293F で発現して複合体を作り、クライオ電顕で解析した。
summary.result: gB 三量体の各分子に D48 Fab が 1 つずつ付き、主に軽鎖が DII ドメインと極性相互作用していた（3.04 Å）。
summary.learned: HCMV・EBV の gB 抗体も DII に結合し、融合前の gB でも抗体と衝突しない。DII は共通の抗原領域らしい。

question.quote: While gB antibodies have been demonstrated to be effective in HSV neutralization [9], currently the structural basis for the antibody neutralization remains elusive

approach.quote: To achieve this, we expressed the HSV-1 gB ectodomain and D48 Fab using the 293F expression system, yielding a stable complex (Figure S1A-S1B).

result.quote: The complex displayed a trimeric configuration, with each gB bound to one D48 Fab along the central axis.
Specifically, D48 establishes polar interactions with the DII domain via its light chain (VL), encompassing an interface area of 462.6 Å2.

learned.quote: revealing a potentially conserved antigenic domain gB DII, across the herpesvirus family, spanning pre- and post-fusion configurations.
with all three antibodies exhibiting superficial binding to pre-fusion gB DII domains devoid of structural conflict (Figure 1K).

highlights.text: D48 の軽鎖の LCDR1・LCDR3・FR2 が gB の DII ドメインと水素結合や塩橋を作る。重鎖側には極性の接触がなく、疎水性残基のまとまりが支えると考えられる。

evidence.quote: Polar contacts, including hydrogen bonds (H-bonds) and salt bridges, were discovered within this interaction region (Figure 1G).
indicating potential hydrophobic interactions in stabilizing the D48 VH-HSV-1 gB interface (Figure S4).

highlights.text: 接触残基を個別にアラニンへ置換すると、どの変異体でも D48 Fab への親和性が約 10 分の 1 に下がった。

evidence.quote: we introduced single-residue alanine mutants to disrupt polar contacts, resulting in an approximate 10-fold decrease in binding affinity (KD) across all mutants (Figures 1G and S3).

highlights.text: HCMV の SM5-1 と EBV の 3A3 も、gB の DII 表面に結合する。DII の配列には保存された残基があるが、3 種の抗体の接触残基は HSV-1・HCMV・EBV で同一ではなく、交差結合は限られると考えられる。

evidence.quote: We found that D48, SM5-1, and 3A3 each bind and extensively cover the superficial surface of the post-fusion DII domain of gB (Figure 1I).
However, no interaction residues of D48, SM5-1, and 3A3 were found to be identical across HSV-1, HCMV, and EBV, suggesting limited cross-herpesvirus binding capability of these antibodies.

lab_notes.expression: HEK293F 細胞で一過性発現（gB、D48 Fab、IgG1）。
lab_notes.construct: gB は HSV-1 KOS の 31–730 残基で、C 末端に Twin-Strep と 8×His タグ。
lab_notes.purification: gB と D48 Fab は Ni Sepharose、IgG1 は Protein A で精製。
lab_notes.sample_prep: Quantifoil R2/1 の Au グリッドに 4 μL を載せ、Vitrobot Mark IV で凍結。
lab_notes.data_collection: Titan Krios G3i と K3 で撮影し、cryoSPARC で解析（C3 対称）。

evidence.quote: the sequence of HSV-1 strain KOS gB 31–730 (gB730) [5] was cloned into the pcDNA3.1 mammalian expression vector fused with N-terminal TPA signal peptide and C-terminal Twin-Strep-tag plus 8∗His tag.
All plasmids were expressed in HEK293F cells (ThermoFisher, Waltham, Massachusetts, USA) by transient transfection [17].
The gB and D48 Fab were purified with Ni Sepharose resin (Cytiva, Shanghai, China) and D48 IgG1 was purified with Protein A Sepharose resin (Cytiva, Shanghai, China).
holey-carbon Au grids (Quantifoil R2/1, 300 mesh) were glow discharged and 4 μL of samples were applied onto the front side of glow-discharged grids.
Datasets of the HSV gB-D48 complex were collected on a 300-kV Titan Krios electron microscope G3i
